children: its full-year financial guidance for the second time in five weeks, citing a strong outlook for international chemistry sales in this year's H2.

now expects FY 2026 total revenue of $360M-$370M, up from its August 4 guidance range of $340M-$350M and above the $345M FactSet analyst consensus estimate, and adjusted EBITDA of $50M-$54M, raised from its previous view of $47M-$51M.
At the new guidance midpoints, FY 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA would increase 54% and 58%, respectively, compared with FY 2025.

The company said Q2 international chemistry revenue jumped more than 450% Q/Q to $10.6M and anticipates that sales in H2 could exceed $40M, supported by ongoing work in Saudi Arabia and coupled with an expanding contribution from its data analytics segment.

title: Flotek raises guidance for 2026 revenue, EBITDA on international chemistry strength
